author: blu
body: Proves upkeep-drain Auras. Cursed Land ("At the beginning of the upkeep of enchanted land's controller, deal 1 to that player") is an Aura carrying UpkeepDrain. Attached to player 0's land, it drains 1 from player 0 at player 0's upkeep. Attached to player 1's land, it does NOT hit player 0 during player 0's upkeep -- the drain follows the enchanted permanent's controller.
